item.title: The Oceanside Museum of Art Builds on Irving Gill's Vision | San Diego Magazine
item.description: The Oceanside Museum of Art begins its expansion into a 1929 fire and police station by San Diego’s most innovative architect.

item.title: 17 Things to Do in San Diego This Weekend: March 18-22 | San Diego Magazine
item.description: The best things to do in San Diego this weekend including the inaugural San Diego Sockers W match and the San Diego Latino Film Festival.

item.title: Vanguard Culture Celebrates 10 Years With Immersive Dinners | San Diego Magazine
item.description: An Artist @ The Table’s immersive dinner series unites creativity through art and food March 20-22 at Chapel in Liberty Station.

item.title: The History of Jackass Mail, San Diego's First Mail Route | San Diego Magazine
item.description: Delivering mail to 1850s San Diego came at a price: desert heat, exhausted mules, Comanche raids, a six-figure loss, and one shipwreck.

item.title: Inside Fleurette, Travis Swikard’s New French Restaurant in SD
item.description: Callie chef Travis Swikard brings classic French technique and San Diego soul to Fleurette, his new cuisine du soleil restaurant in La Jolla.

item.title: Iconic Dudley’s Bakery Gets a Fresh (French) Future | San Diego Magazine
item.description: New owners Michel Malécot and Michael Brewer promise to maintain the 63-year-old bakery legacy while making a few improvements.

item.title: Health and Wellness Spring 2026 | San Diego Magazine
item.description: Look and feel your best with an assist from these health and wellness experts

item.title: Oceanside’s Kettle On Coast Reimagines the Coffee Shop Model | San Diego Magazine
item.description: Chef David Lay’s menu for Kettle On Coast is a unique and ambitious concept for the former Petite Madeline space.

item.title: The Locals' Guide to Visiting Imperial Beach, CA | San Diego Magazine
item.description: Experience world-famous surf breaks, authentic Mexican food, and laid-back vibes in this beach town just five miles from the border.

item.title: Koakai Brewing Brings Japanese Influence to Local Beer Scene | San Diego Magazine
item.description: Award-winning brewer and North County native Mike Aubuchon’s long-awaited brewery set to open this April in Oceanside.
